sa: एते द्रवन्ति पाञ्चाला द्राव्यन्ते योधिभिर्बुवम्। कर्णेन भरतश्रेष्ठ पश्य पश्य तथाकृतान्॥
en: O Bharata! See here, these Panchala warriors racing. Karna and other warriors are so making them to run so haphazard. Look there, they are trapped in a worst network.

sa: एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व विस्तरेण महामुने। न हि तृप्यामि पूर्वेषां शृण्वानश्चरितं महत्॥
en: Relate to me all these in their entirety, as they had really taken place. I am not (at all) satisfied with (simply) hearing the mighty achievements of my forefathers.

sa: संजय उवाच मद्राधिपस्याधिरथिर्महात्मा वचो निशम्याप्रियमप्रतीतः। उवाच शल्यं विदितं ममैतद् यथाविधावर्जुनवासुदेवौ॥
en: Sanjaya said Listening to those unpleasant words and not being convinced the high-souled car-warrior, the king of Madra, said to Shalya "I know well what Vasudeva and Arjuna are.

sa: स तमुवीक्ष्य राजानं कश्मलाभिहतौजसम्। ववन्दे प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा मूर्धा पादौ नृपस्य ह॥
en: He then beholding the king deprived of energy in consequence of his gloominess of mind, folded his hands; and indeed, worshipped the monarch's feet by bowing down his head.

sa: तस्मै सदा प्रयच्छन्ति वैश्यपुत्राः कुमारकाः॥ मांसौदन दधि क्षीरं पायसं मधुसर्पिषी।
en: There was a crow who lived upon the leavings of the well-behaved children of the Vaishya. His children always gave the crow meat, curds, mild, pudding, honey and butter.

sa: पार्थस्य सचिवः कृष्णो यथाभीषुग्रहो वरः। तथा त्वमपि राधेयं सर्वतः परिपालया॥
en: Even as Krishna, that foremost one amongst all the charioteers, is the adviser of the son of Pritha, so you would support the son of Radha in all ways.

sa: प्रचिच्छेदाशु भल्लेन द्विषतामाततायिनाम्। शस्त्रं पाणिं तथा बाहुं तथापि च शिरांस्युत॥
en: With his broad-headed arrows he began to chop off quickly the heads, thighs and arms with weapon in the grasp of his rivals who were desirous of killing him.

sa: ततः प्रयातो देवेशः सर्वैर्देवगणैर्वृतः॥८६॥ रथेन महता राजन्नुपमा नास्ति यस्य ह।
en: Thereupon, O monarch, that lord of the celestials, riding upon that mighty car, which had no equal, proceeded on, having been encompassed by the whole lot of, the celestials.

sa: इत्युक्तः परुषं वाक्यं पार्षतेन द्विजोत्तमः॥ क्रोधपाहारयत् तीव्र तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्।
en: That foremost of the twice-born ones (i.e. Ashvatthama), thus addressed in harsh words by the son of Prishata, became terrible excited with wrath and said (to Dhristadyumna) “Wait, wait."

sa: काक उवाच उच्छिष्टदर्पितो हंस मन्येऽऽत्मानं सुपर्णवत्। अवमन्य बहूंचाहं काकानन्यांश्च पक्षिणः॥
en: The crow said "Rendered arrogant by feeding upon the leavings of others' food I thought myself as equal to Garuda and did not care for crows and other birds.

sa: हैडिम्बश्चाप्युपायेन शक्त्या कर्णेन घातितः। यदि ह्येनं नाहनिष्यत् कर्णः शक्त्या महामृधे॥
en: Through our tactics Karna used that Sakti of his in felling the son of Hidimba. If on the other hand, Karna had not slain this Rakshasa by his Sakti.

sa: तमपि ग्रहसन् द्रोणः शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्। महाव्याघ्रो महारण्ये मृगशावं यथा बली॥
en: Him also Diona smilingly dispatched to the mansion of Death by means of his shafts, like a large and ferocious tiger slaying a young deer in the deep forest.

sa: एते ते पृथिवीपालाः सृञ्जयाश्च समागताः। त्वां सभासाद्य दुर्धर्षं पाण्डवाश्च व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: These potentates and these united forces of the Srinjayas and these Pandavas have been successful in holding their ground, only because they have such an unflinching leader in you.

sa: सुहृदस्त्वद्धिते युक्तान् भीष्मद्रोणमुखान् परैः। निहतान् युधि संस्मृत्य कचिन्न कुरुषे व्यथाम्॥
en: Remembering that your friends, Bhishma, Drona and others, who were ever occupied in contributing to your welfare, were slain by the enemies in battle, do you not feel pain?

sa: ततोऽपराभ्यां भल्लाभ्यां धनुषी समकृन्तत। यमयोः सहसा राजन् विव्याध च त्रिसप्तभिः॥
en: Then he cut-off the bows of both of those two warriors with two of his broad-pointed arrows and suddenly, O king he pierced both of them with twenty-one arrows.

sa: कर्णो जाम्बूनदैर्जालैः संछन्नान् वातरंहसः। हयान् विव्याध भीमस्य पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः शरैः॥
en: Then the heroic Karna pierced each of the steeds of Bhima with five shafts, steeds that were decked with golden caparisons and endued with the fleetness of the wind.

sa: त्वत्प्रियार्थ महाराज जयो दैवे प्रतिष्ठितः। अद्य योत्स्येऽर्जुनमहं पौरुषं स्वं व्यपाश्रितः॥
en: And also for accomplishing what would conduce to your good, O monarch. But, o king, victory depends upon Destiny. Relying on my prowess, I shall today fight with Arjuna.

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वाप्रदुतान् संख्ये सात्वतेन शरार्दितान्। प्रभग्नं पुनरेवासीत् तव सैन्यं समाकुलम्॥
en: Then once more seeing all those heroes routed and afflicted by the scion of the Satvata race, your troops once more began to give way, being overwhelmed with fear.

sa: शक्तितस्तात युध्यामस्त्यक्त्वा प्राणानभीतवत्। अहं कर्णश्च शल्यश्च कृपो हार्दिक्य एव च।
en: O affectionate one, putting forth our (utmost) strength engage in fight dauntlessly regardless of our very lives. Myself we Karna, Shalya, Kripa and the son of Hridika i.e., Kritavarma.

sa: त्वमागाः समरं वीर क्षात्रधर्ममनुस्मरन्। ततो विनिहत: संख्ये युद्धधर्मो हि निष्ठुरः॥
en: O hero, you proceeded against me with hostile intentions, bearing in mind the duties of a Kshatriya. You were ever engaged in doing our, special the king's (Yudhishthira's) good.

sa: विशेषतो हि नृपतेस्तथास्माकं हिते रतः। न्यायतोऽन्यायतो वापि हतः शेते महाद्युतिः॥
en: It is therefore not fit that I should lament for you, O your of great effulgence.” O mighty monarch then slaying them before the very eyes of Radha's son.

sa: सैन्धवो निहतो युद्धे परं यत्नं कुर्वतां च त्वया सार्धं रणाजिरे॥
en: The king of Sindhu has been killed in battle. It seems that fate is supreme. Though we have been making vigorous exertions with you on the field of battle.

sa: पृथक् पृथग्लोकपाला: समेता ददुर्महास्राण्यमेयाणि संख्ये। यैस्ताञ्जघानाशु रणे नृसिंहः सकालकेयानसुरान् समेतान्॥
en: When he-that first among men, exterminated all the Kalakhanja Asuras, he received from the different regents of the world many weapons of unfathomable power with which he slew them.

sa: पीमस्तमाह च ततः प्रतिज्ञामनुचिन्तयन्। नायं वध्यस्तव नृप इत्युक्तः स न्यवर्तत॥
en: Thereupon Bhima, recollecting his own vow, uttered these words 'O prince, (Yudhishthira), this one is not to be slaughtered by you.' Being thus addressed Yudhishthira abstained (from slaying him).

sa: धारणाद् धर्ममित्याहुर्धर्मो धारयते प्रजाः। यत् स्याद् धारणसंयुक्तंस धर्म इति निश्चयः॥
en: Dharma (morality) is so-called because it protects all. Indeed, morality saves all creatures. Surely then that is morality which is capable of keeping off a creature from all injuries.

sa: संजय उवाच ततः पुनः समाजग्मुरभीताः कुरुसृञ्जयाः। युधिष्ठिरमुखाः पार्थाः सूतपुत्रमुखा वयम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then again the Kurus and Srinjayas undauntedly encountered one another. The sons of Pritha were headed by Yudhishthira and our army was headed by the charioteer's son.

sa: भीषयन् सर्वसैन्यानि कौरवेयाणि दुर्मते॥ अत्रापि शृणु मे वाक्यं रथावदब्रुवतो द्विजा
en: In order to strike terror into the hearts of) all the troops and the Kauravas, O evil-minded one, O son of Goutama, hear what I say on this point.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नसतु तान् दृष्ट्वा तव राजन् रथर्षभान्। यमाभ्यां वारितान् वीराज्छीघ्रास्रो द्रोणमभ्ययात्॥
en: Then Dhristadyumna, very quick in the use of weapons and beholding those brave and mighty car-warriors of your army, resisted by the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva), rushed upon Drona.

sa: मम युद्धं प्रयच्छध्वं दैत्या युद्धमदोत्कटाः। प्रेषिता देवदेवेन वो विजेतुं महासुराः॥
en: Most invincible in battle as you are, O Daityas, do you give me battle. I had been sent by the lord of the celestials to subdue the mighty Asuras.

sa: तं हतं संयुगे कश्चिदस्मै शंसतु मानवः। एतन्नारोचयद् राजन् कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Let some one among us therefore tell him that Ashvatthaman has been slain in the battle, But O king, Kunti's son Dhananjaya did not accept this advice of Krishna.

sa: कथं पतितवृत्तस्य पृथिवी सुहृदां दुहः। विवरं नाशकद् दातुं मम पार्थिवसंसदि।॥
en: I have fallen from virtue; an evil-minded and an enemy to my friends as I am why does not the earth yield me a hole (to bury me in).

sa: भीमसेनं ततः क्रुद्धोविव्याध त्रिंशता शरैः॥ सहदेवस्य भल्लेन ध्वज चिच्छेद मारिष। सारथिं च त्रिभिर्बाणैराजघान परंतपः॥ विरथान् द्रौपदेयांश्च चकार भरतर्षभ। अक्ष्णौनिमेषमात्रेण तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: And then, with great violence, struck Bhimasena with thirty shafts. That scorcher of foes, O sire, next struck off Sahadeva's standard with a flat-faced arrow and then pierced his charioteer with three others. He, O foremost of the Bharata race, almost in no time, deprived the (five) sons of Draupadi of their chariots and it seemed truly wonderful.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीन्मा याचन्तमपराधं प्रयत्नतः। व्याहृतं यन्मया सूत तत् तथा न तदन्यथा॥
en: He then said to nie who had offered him and thus implored his forgiveness.” What I have said, O Suta, will surely take place. It can never be otherwise.

sa: इह चेल्लभ्यते लक्ष्यं कृत्स्नाञ्जेष्यामहे परान्। एष पाञ्चालराजस्य पुत्रो द्रोणेन संगतः॥
en: But here in our middle stays Satyaki the foremost of the Satvatas; if this object o our aim could be smitten down, we might obtain victory over our foes.

sa: सर्वधर्मोपपन्नोऽयं स मे शिष्यश्च पाण्डवः॥ नायं वदति मिथ्येति प्रत्ययं कृतवांस्त्वयि।
en: “The son of Pandu is accomplished in all virtues; moreover he is my disciple, he will never tell me a lic.' Thinking this Drona believed what you then said.

sa: सशरं तद् धनुर्घोरं संन्यस्याथ रथे ततः। खड्गी रथादवप्लुत्य सहसा द्रोणमभ्ययात्॥
en: Then placing his dreadful bow with arrows fixed on its string on his car, he jumped down from it armed with a sword and then rushed furiously upon Drona.

sa: स तेनाभिहतो राजन् मूर्छामाशु समाविशत्॥ ध्वजयष्टिं च सहसा शिश्रिये कश्मलावृतः।
en: O monarch, he, being thus wounded by that arrow, fall into the condition of insensibility; and he, being so choked with stupefaction, suddenly supported himself by holding his flag-staff.

sa: कृतवर्मा महाराज पार्षतं निशितैः शरैः॥ रणे विव्याध सप्तत्या स्वर्णपुङः शिलाशितैः।
en: O great king, Kritavarman pierced the son of Prishata in the battle with seventy sharp arrows, that were furnished with golden wings and also that were whetted on atone.

sa: अन्योन्यं समरे क्रुद्धौ कृतप्रतिकृतैषिणौ। ततो भीमो महाबाहुः सूतपुत्रस्य भारत॥ क्षुरप्रेण धनुश्छित्त्वा ननाद परवीरहा। तदपास्य धनुश्छिन्नं सूतपुत्रो महारथः॥ अन्यत् कार्मुकमादत्त भारघ्नं वेगवत्तरम्।
en: Inflamed with rage, each endeavoured to counteract the feats of the other in battle. Then that slayer of hostile heroes, viz., Bhima of mighty arms, O Bharata, cutting off with a razor-headed arrow the bow of Karna, uttered a loud war-cry. Then leaving aside that severed bow, the son of Suta that mighty car-warrior took up a tougher and stronger bow.

sa: ईदृशैर्यद्यहं दुःखैन विनश्यामि संजय॥ वज्राद् दृढतरं मन्ये हृदयं मम दुर्भिदम्।
en: O Sanjaya, when having been afflicted with such a grief as this, I do not die, I suppose that my heart is harder than the thunderbolt and most impenetrable.

sa: द्रवमाणे तथा सैन्ये त्रस्तरूपे हतौजसि। प्रतिस्रोत इव ग्राहो द्रोणपुत्रः परानियात्॥
en: Warriors, mounting on the steeds or using their legs, fled in all possible haste. While the troops, with their splendour lost and filled with fear, were thus flying away.

sa: एवंभूतो हि यो विप्रः सत्पथं सत्पथे स्थितः। आहिताग्निरधीयानो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
en: That Brahmana who always acts thus, following the path of virtue, adoring his sacred fire, and engaged in the study of the Vedas, comes to be considered as Brahma.

sa: तदाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते भव त्वं कालकाक्षिणी। नचिराद् द्रक्ष्यसे रामं प्रज्वलन्तमिवानलम्॥
en: Therefore, do you take heart, good betide you! Do you remain, eagerly wishing for the time. It will not be long before you shall behold Rāma resembling flaming fire.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एते रथास्तवाख्यातास्तथैवातिरथा नृप। ये चाप्यर्धरथा राजन् पाण्डवानामत: शृणु।॥
en: Bhishma said These are the notable Rathas and Atirathas on your side, O ruler of men, and these, o king, are semi-Rathas; listen now to those of the Pandavas.

sa: स तथा सत्कृतो राज्ञा मासमुष्य तदा नृप। प्रययौ पुष्करो हृष्टः स्वपुरं स्वजनावृतः॥ महत्या सेनया साधू विनीतैः परिचारकैः। भ्राजमान इवादित्यो वपुषा पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: O monarch, having been thus honoured by the king (his brother, Nala). Pushkara, gratified at heart, then repaired to his own city attended by his relatives, after he has passed about a month with his brother. O foremost of men, also attended by a great force and humble servants, Pushkara went away; and he looked like the resplendent sun in appearance.

sa: लक्ष्म्या समुदितो ब्राह्मया ब्रह्मभूतो महातपाः। ब्राह्मण तपसा युक्तं पुत्रमिच्छामि धार्मिकम्॥
en: You are furnished with the Brāhma marks, art sprung from Brahmă, and art of mighty austerities. I desire of you a righteous son endowed with the Brāhma ascetic virtues.

sa: प्रणम्य विकचः पादावगृहणात् स पितुस्तदा। मातुश्च परमेष्वासस्तौ च नामास्य चक्रतुः॥
en: That bad featured child, that mighty bowman, soon after his birth, bowed down to his mother and also to his father and touched their feet. They then named him.

sa: अतोनिमित्तं त्रस्तोऽहं रामेण तु महात्मना। यन्ममोपकृतं शक्यं प्रतिकर्तुं न तन्मया॥
en: I have not done him any good proportionate to what the high-souled Rāma had done for me; and it is for this reason that I am afraid of him.

sa: अन्योन्यमभिसंरब्धा ग्रहाश्च न चकाशिरे। मेघाश्च खरनिर्घोषा रथस्योपरि रक्षसः॥ ववधू रुधिरं चास्य सिषिचुश्च पुरःसरान्। केतुमूर्धनि गृध्रस्तु विलीनो दक्षिणामुखः॥ नदन्नुभयतः पार्श्व समयां श्रियमाहरन्।
en: And enraged at each other, the planetary bodies were shorn of their brightness. And clouds emitting sharp sounds, showered down blood upon the car, and those marching in front were washed therewith. And alighting at the top of the standard, a vulture set up cries, facing the south and began to prick both its sides, thereby depriving (Prahasta) of his grace.

sa: फलं कर्मात्मकं विद्यात् कर्म ज्ञेयात्मकं तथा। ज्ञेयं ज्ञानात्मकं विद्याजानं सदसदात्मकम्॥
en: Fruits, therefore, have actions as their cause. Actions have the understanding for their root. The understanding has knowledge for its ot, and knowledge has the Soul for its cause.

sa: अप्यहेरारुजन् दंष्ट्रामाश्वेव निधनं व्रजा अपि वा संशयं प्राप्य जीवितेऽपि पराक्रमः॥
en: Rather die in the act of rooting out the fangs of a snake than roam about like a dog and exercise your prowess even at the risk of life.

sa: प्रदुद्रुवुस्ततस्तेऽन्य पुत्रास्तव विशाम्पते। मन्यमाना हि तत् सत्यं सभायां तस्य भाषितम्॥
en: Then O ruler of men, the rest of your sons fled away in all directions, considering that the words he had uttered in the assembly hall to be true.

sa: पाण्डवैः संशमं कृत्वा कृत्वा च सुहृदां वचः। सम्प्रीयमाणोमित्रैश्च चिरं भद्राण्यवाप्सस्यसि॥
en: Having effected peace with the sons of Pandu and listening to the advice to your friends and living in peace with your friends will you ever attain to blessing.

sa: न ह्येको भृत्यरहितो राजा भवति रक्षिता। राज्यं चेदं जनः सर्वस्तत्कुलीनोऽभिकाङ्क्षति॥
en: If the king choose to act alone and without servants, he can never protect his people. All persons, however, of high birth wish for the acquisition of sovereignty? us

sa: संरक्षितो भीमसेनेन राजा माद्रीसुताभ्यामथ माधवेन। मद्राधिपं पत्रिभिरुपवेगैः स्तनान्तरे धर्मसुतो निजघ्ने॥
en: Protected by Bhimasena and the two sons of Madri and Krishna the royal son of Dharma struck the king of the Madras on the chest with powerful winged arrows.

sa: धर्ममेवाविशत् क्षत्ता राजा चैव युधिष्ठिरः॥ अनन्तो भगवान् देवः प्रविवेश रसातलम्।
en: Both Kshatri and king Yudhishthira entered into the God of Virtue. The holy and illustrious Ananta (who had taken birth as Balarama) went to the region below the Earth.

sa: वादित्रशब्दस्तुमुलः शङ्खभेरीविमिश्रितः। शूराणां रणशूराणां गर्जतामितरेतरम्। उभयोः सेनयो राजन् महान् व्यतिकरोऽभवत्॥
en: The loud sounds of musical instruments, mingled with that of the conches and drums, and the shouts of brave warriors, that rose fearfully roaring at one another, were awful.

sa: मैनाकात् परतो राजन् गोविन्दो गिरिरुत्तमः। गोविन्दात् परतो राजन् निबिडो नाम पर्वतः॥ परस्तु द्विगुणस्तेषां विष्कम्भो वंशवर्धन। देशांस्तत्र प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे निगदतः शृणु।॥
en: O king, next to Mainaka is that best of mountains called Govinda, next to Govinda is the Nibida mountain. O perpetuator of the Kuru race, the intervening spaces between one another of these mountains increase in the ratio of one to two. I shall speak of the countries that are situated there. Hear as I tell of them.

sa: आपदस्तरणे प्राणान् धारयेद् येन तेन वा। सर्वमावृत्य कर्तव्यं तं धर्ममनुवर्तता॥
en: It is consonant with the precepts of religion that one should protect his life by any means. He, who seeks to do it, should not scruple about the means.

sa: संजय उवाच समं व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु भूयिष्ठेष्वनिवर्तिनः। ब्रह्मलोकपराः सर्वे समपद्यन्त भारत॥ न ह्यनीकमनीकेन समसज्जत संकुले। रथा न रथिभिः सार्ध पादाता न पदातिभिः॥
en: Sanjaya said When the division of the two armies strong in numbers and arranged in order of battle, met one another, all the unretreating heroes, O Bharata, then rushed to battle keeping in view the regions of Brahma. In that pell-mell fight, neither similar divisions fought with their similar, not car-warriors with car-warriors, nor foot-soldier with their foot-soldiers.

sa: अमावास्यां महाराज नित्यशः शशलक्षणः। स्नात्वा ह्याप्यायते श्रीमान् प्रभासे तीर्थ उत्तमे॥
en: On everyday of the new moon, O king, the god, having the hare for his mark, bathes in the excellent tirtha of Prabhasa and regains his form and beauty.

sa: यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान् यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः। प्रेतान् भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः॥
en: Those who are of the Sattva quality worship the celestial, those of Raja worship Yakshas and Rakshasas, and those of Tama do the same to departed spirits and ghosts.

sa: इमान् हि पुरुषव्याघ्रानचिन्त्यबलपौरुषान्। आत्तशस्त्रान् रणे दृष्ट्वा न व्यथेदिह कः पुमान्॥
en: What man is there who, seeing these tigers among men of inconceivable strength and prowess and ready for battle with all their arms, will not be struck with fear?

sa: वयं तु तेजसा तस्य सहसा हृतचेतसः॥ न किंचिदपि पश्यामो हतचक्षुर्बलेन्द्रियाः।
en: As regards ourselves, we were suddenly deprived of our senses by his Energy. Shorn of vision and strength and all the senses, we could not behold or feel anything.

sa: न चिरात् प्राप्यते लोके पापानां कर्मणां फलम्। सविषाणामिवान्नानां भुक्तानां क्षणदाचर॥
en: O ranger of night, as the effect of having taken rice mixed with poison, appears without delay, even so also people readily reap the fruit of their own acts.

sa: अङ्गारचूर्णोत्करसंनिकाशैः फलैः सुपर्याप्तरसैः समृद्धैः। जम्बूदुमाणां प्रविभान्ति शाखा निपीयमाना इव षट्पदौघैः॥
en: The branches of rose-apple trees containing enough of fruits like to a collection of char coal are so appearing as if the black bees are drinking the juice thereof.

sa: सुवाससः सुवेषाश्च ते च सर्वे शुचिव्रताः। हितार्थाश्च नरेन्द्रस्य जाग्रतो नयचक्षुषा॥
en: And the ministers wore excellent raiment, and ornaments, and were engaged in observing pure Vows, and ever kept their eye of policy open in the interest of the monarch.

sa: बृहद् ब्रह्म महच्चेति शब्दाः पर्यायवाचकाः। एभिः समन्वितो राजन् गुणैर्विद्वान् बृहस्पतिः॥
en: The words Vrihat, Brahma, and Mahat all carry the same significance. The celestial priest, O king, came to be called Brihaspati because he was gifted with all these accomplishments.

sa: लङ्का चारयितव्या मे पुनरेव भवेदिति। रात्रौ नहि सुदृष्टा मे दुर्गकर्मविधानतः॥
en: I shall once more range around Lankā. Let this be so. At night I could not satisfactorily examine the fortifications.* (Another meaning is:-lts places inaccessible on account of works.)

sa: सीतामिहानयस्वेति को ब्रवीति ब्रवीहि मे। रक्षोलोकस्य सर्वस्य कः शृङ्ग छेत्तुमिच्छति॥
en: Tell me, who is it that has told you, 'Bring Sītā hither?' Who is it that has set his heart on severing the summit of the entire Räksasa world?

sa: तां तु दृष्ट्वा निपतितां हतपुत्रपरिच्छदाम्। चुक्रोश कुन्ती दुःखार्ता सर्वाश्च भरतस्त्रियः॥
en: Sceing the princess fallen on the earth deprived of her son and with her body uncovered, Kunti as also all the (other) Bharata-ladies, deeply afflicted, began to weep aloud.

sa: विमुक्ताः सर्व एवैते महत्त्वमुपयान्त्युत। आत्मनो महतो वेद यः पुण्यां गतिमुत्तमाम्॥
en: All these, shorn of all attachments attain to the status of Greatness. That, person who understands that holy and high goal, viz., the Great Soul becomes freed from delusion.

sa: ततो विभज्यमानेषु बलेषु बलिनां वरः। प्रोवाच भ्रातरं कृष्णं रौहिणेयो महामनाः॥
en: After this, while the troops of both parties were being collected and arrayed, the great son of Rohini, that foremost of all powerful persons, said to his brother Krishna.

sa: गतिश्च सर्वभूतानां प्रजनश्चापि भारत। व्याप्ता मे रोदसी पार्थ कान्तिश्चाभ्यधिका मम॥
en: I am the end of all creatures and their father, O Bharata. I pervade the entire sky and the Earth. O Partha. and my splendour transcends every other splendour.

sa: भीष्म उवाच समुद्यतोऽयं भारो मे सुमहान् सागरोपमः। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य संग्रामे वर्षपूगाभिचिन्तितः॥
en: Bhishma said The great burden (the impending fight) vast as the ocean is ready to fall on me, a calamity which I had foreseen for a series of years,

sa: पुष्करे तु कुरुक्षेत्रे गङ्गायां मध्यमेषु या स्नात्वा तारयते जन्तुः सप्तसप्तावरांस्तथा॥
en: Bathing in Pushkara in Kurukshetra and in the Ganges and in the confluence of the Ganges and the Yamuna), one saves ten generations of his race upwards and downwards.

sa: स प्रयाहि महाराज श्रिया परमया युतः। तापयन् पाण्डुपुत्रांस्त्वं रश्मिवानिव तेजसा॥
en: O king, go there with all your prosperity and thus scorch the Pandavas with a sight of your glory, as the sun scorches every thing with his hot rays.

sa: एकशीलैश्च मित्रत्वं भजन्ते पापकर्मिणः। स तेन दुःखमाप्नोति परत्र च विपद्यते॥
en: These men of evil deeds form friendship with men of similar character and therefore as its result, they suffer misery in this world as well as in the next.

sa: योऽसौ राजा घृणी नित्यं धार्तराष्ट्रेषु भारत। निकृत्या भ्रंशितः क्रोधान्नोन्मीलयति लोचने।॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the king (Yudhisthira) is always kind to the sons of Dhritarashtra. Deprived of kingdom by foul means, he does not open his eyes in anger.

sa: स त्वं सात्वतमुख्याध लब्धसंज्ञो यदृच्छया। पश्य मे हयसंयाने शिक्षा केशवनन्दन॥
en: O foremost of the Satyatas, O son of Keshava, now that you have regained your senses, without further trouble you will now see my skill in guiding the horses.

sa: तथैव वेदवचनं श्रूयते नित्यदा विभो। संवत्सरो महाराज पूर्णो भवति कृच्छ्रतः॥
en: O illustrious one, the Veda text is often heard to signify that a year, O great monarch, passes away like a day, if one is engaged in strict devotion.

sa: स्पन्दतामपि नागानां मार्गा नष्टा वनोद्भवाः। मार्ग संस्थ्य संसुप्तं पद्मिन्याः सार्थमुत्तमम्॥
en: The course of the rushing elephants through the paths of the woods was hindered, as the good caravan was sleeping, obstructing the way to the lake filled with lotuses.

sa: त्रयोदशं च सजने अज्ञाता: परिवत्सरम्। ज्ञाताश्च पुनरन्यानि वने वर्षाणि द्वादश॥
en: The thirteenth year shall have to be spent in some inhabited country without being recognised. If recognised, an exile for another twelve years shall be the consequence(of such recognition).

sa: त्वं तु केवलबाल्येन धार्तराष्ट्र विदीर्यसे। यद् ब्रवीषि सभामध्ये बालः स्थविरभाषितम्॥
en: O son of Dhritarashtra, you alone for your boyish age are bursting into rage. Though you are but a boy, you speak as if you are an old man.

sa: धारयिष्ये महाभाग गगनात् प्रच्युतां शिवाम्। दिव्यां देवनदी पुण्यां त्वत्कृते नृपसत्तम॥
en: "O mighty-armed hero, O foremost of kings, for your sake I shall sustain (on may head) the fall from the sky of that blessed divine and pure, celestials river.”

sa: सतां धर्मेण वर्तेत क्रियां शिष्टवदाचरेत्। असंक्लेशेन लोकस्य वृत्तिं लिप्सेत वै द्विज॥ सन्ति ह्यागमविज्ञानाः शिष्टाः शास्त्रे विचक्षणाः। स्वधर्मेण क्रिया लोके कर्मणः सोऽप्यसंकरः॥
en: O Brahmana, man must follow the standard of virtue of the good; and in his acts he must imitate the example of the virtuous. There are virtuous men learned in the holy Shastras and conversant in all moralities. Man's proper duty consists in his following his own proper avocations such being the case, these avocations never become confused and mixed up.

sa: आपृच्छे त्वां गमिष्यामि द्वारकां कुरुनन्दन। राजसूयं क्रतुश्रेष्ठं दिष्ट्या त्वं प्राप्तवानसि॥
en: Krishna said. o descendant of Kuru, of Kuru, with permission I shall now go to Dwarka. By good fortune you have accomplished the best of sacrifices, Rajasuya. with your

sa: न गाथागाथिनं शास्ति बहु चेदपि गायति। प्रकृति यान्ति भूतानि भूलिङ्गशकुनिर्यथा॥
en: The verses that a chaunter chaunts, though he chants them often, would produce no impression on him. every creature acts according to his own disposition like the bird Bhulinga.

sa: ब्रह्मर्षे श्रूयतां यत् ते मनसैतद् विवक्षितम्। नायं केवलमर्यो वै मानुषत्वमुपागतः॥
en: Indra said: O Brahmarshi, hear all about what is now passing in your mind. This one (Arjuna) is not a mortal, though he has taken his birth among men.

sa: ग्रहीष्यन्तं तु तं सोममश्विनोरुत्तमं तदा। समीक्ष्य बलभिद् देव इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having seen that he was about to take up an excellent portion of Soma to offer it to the Ashvins, the destroyer of Bala Indra thus spoke to hiin,

sa: तेषां प्रविशतां तत्र मार्गमावृत्य भारत। दीप्ताक्षं भीषणं रक्षः सोल्मुकं प्रत्यपद्यत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, as they (the Pandavas) were entering that forest, a fearful Rakshasas with flaming eyes stood before them with a lighted brand and obstructed their path.

sa: अपश्यद् वैशसं तत्र सर्वलोकभयंकरम्। अदृष्टपूर्वं तद् दृष्ट्वा बाला पद्मनिभेक्षणा॥ संसक्तवदनाश्वासा उत्तस्थौ भयविह्वला। ये तु तत्र विनिर्मुक्ताः सार्थात् केचिदविक्षताः॥ तेऽब्रुवन् सहिताः सर्वे कस्येदं कर्मणः फलम्। नूनं न पूजितोऽस्माभिर्मणिभद्रो महायशाः॥ तथा यक्षाधिपः श्रीमान् न वै वैश्रवणः प्रभुः। न पूजा विघ्नकर्तृणामथवा प्रथमं कृता॥ शकुनानां फलं वाथ विपरीतमिदंध्रुवम्। ग्रहा न विपरीतास्तु किमन्यदिदमागतम्॥
en: There the maiden, possessing eyes like the lotus-leaves, saw the effects of that unforeseen accident. viz., the slaughter, which meant to frighten all the worlds. On her awakening, she became insensible with fear; and also with an affected countenance, she became out of breath. Those of the caravan, who escaped from the slaughter unhurt, all assembled together and talked on the action of which that (the slaughter) was the result. 'Surely we have not worshipped that well-reputed Maharudra or that auspicious and magnanimous king of the Yakshas, Vaisravana. Or it might be that we have not worshipped the deities that cause distresses. Or perhaps we have not paid them the first offerings. 'Or this unnatural circumstance is the sure result of the birds (we beheld). Our presiding stars unfavourab

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच गतेषु लोकपालेषु पार्थः शत्रुनिबर्हणः। चिन्तयामास राजेन्द्र देवराजरथं प्रति।।।।
en: Vaishampayana said : O king of kings, after the Lokapalas had gone away, Partha, the repressor of enemies, began to think of the chariot of the king of celestials.

sa: जघानाथ ततो जिष्णुः किरातमुरसा बली। पाण्डवं च विचेष्टं किरातोऽप्यहनद् बली॥
en: The powerful Jishnu (Arjuna), clasping the Kirata (with his both arms) began to press him with his breast. The greatly strong Kirata (also) pressed the insensible son of Pandu.

sa: मनसा वचसा चैव यथा नाभिचराम्यहम्। तेन सत्येन विबुधास्तमेव प्रदिशन्तु मे॥
en: As I am always firm to him either in speech or thought, so for the sake of that truth, it beloves the celestials to point him out to me.

sa: एवमुक्ता स्मितं कृत्वा सम्मानं बहु मन्य च। प्रत्युवाचोर्वशी प्रीता चित्रसेनमनिन्दिता॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed, Urvashi of faultless feature received the words of Chitrasena with high respect. She then smiled and replied to him thus with cheerfulness.

sa: यस्त्वस्य कथित: सत्यो गुणोद्देशस्त्वया मम। तं श्रुत्वाव्यथयं पुंसो वृणुयां किमतोऽर्जुनम्॥
en: Urvashi said: Having heard the virtues that should adorn men, as told by you I would bestow my favours upon any man, why should I not then choose Arjuna?

sa: मेधाविकं समासाद्य पितृन् देवांश्च तर्पयेत्। अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति स्मृति मेधां च विन्दति॥
en: Going then to Medhavika, one should offer oblations to the Pitris and the celestials. By doing this, obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma (sacrifices) and also obtains memory and intellect.

sa: एवं सर्वेषु भूतेषु भूतात्मा सम्प्रकाशते। दृश्यते त्वङ्घयया बुद्ध्या सूक्ष्मया ज्ञानवेदिभिः॥
en: Thus in all these elements the eternal spirit does not show itself, but is perceived by the learned in spiritual science by reason of their high and keen perception.

sa: इतः प्रयाता राजेन्द्र पाण्डवा द्यूतनिर्जिताः। जग्मुस्त्रिभिरहोरात्रैः काम्यकं नाम तद् वनम्॥
en: O king of kings, having been defeated at dice, the Pandavas departed from this place. Travelling for three days and three nights, they arrived at a forest, called Kamyaka.

sa: गत्वा गत्वा नलो राजा पुनरेति सभां मुहुः। आकृष्यमाणः कलिना सौहृदेनावकृष्यते॥
en: The royal Nala departing again and again, returned again and again to the inn, once dragged away by Kali and again drawn back by his love (to his wife).

sa: भीम उवाच पाण्डवो भीमसेनोऽहंधर्मराजादनन्तरः। विशाला बदरीं प्राप्तो भ्रातृभिः सह राक्षसाः॥
en: Bhima said: I am Bhimasena, the son of Pandu. I am next in birth to Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira). O Rakshasas, I had come with my brother to the great Badari.

sa: यदास्थितो रथं दिव्यं पदान चलितः पदम्। देवराजोऽपि हि मया नित्यमत्रोपलक्षितः॥ विचलन् प्रथमोत्पाते हयानां भरतर्षभ। त्वं पुनः स्थित एवात्र रथे भ्रान्ते कुरूद्वह॥
en: That placed in this celestials car you are not jerked even a step from your seat. O best of the Bharatas, I have often noticed that (even) the king of the gods is unable to keep up his balance at the first pull by the horses. O perpetuator of the Kuru race, your sitting (steadily) in the car while in motion,

sa: शृण्वन्तु मे महीपाला येनैतत् क्षमितं मया। अपराधशतं क्षाम्यं मातुरस्यैव याचने॥
en: Krishna said O rulers of earth, hear why this man has been hither to pardoned by me. Asked by his mother, I promised to pardon his one hundred offences.

sa: दर्श च पौर्णमासे च यस्येह हविरुच्यते। विष्णुर्नामेह योऽग्निस्तु धृतिमान्नाम सोऽङ्गिराः॥
en: The fire in whose honour oblations of Ghee are poured in the Darsha and Paurnamasya sacrifices is known as Vishnu in this world. He is called Dhritiman or Angira.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा सुसंरब्धा रथैः सर्वे पृथक्पृथका निर्ययुः पाण्डवान् हन्तुं सहिताः कृतनिश्चयाः॥
en: Having said this, each of them being full of hopes of success separately mounted their chariots. They then started in a body with the resolve of killing the Pandavas.

sa: अद्यास्य यातयिष्यामि तद् वैरं चिरसम्भृतम्। तर्पयिष्यामि च बकं रुधिरेणास्य भूरिणा॥
en: I shall today kill him; and (I shall now) wreak my vengeance on my old enemy. I shall gratify (the manes) of Baka with plentiful blood of his (body).

sa: अद्याहमनृणो भूत्वा भ्रातुः सख्युस्तथैव च। शान्तिं लब्धास्मि परमां हत्वा राक्षसकण्टकम्॥
en: I shall today be freed from my debts which I owe to my friend and brother. I shall obtain great peace by killing today this enemy of the Rakshasas.

sa: ये तु पुत्रकृताच्छोकाद् भृशं व्याकुलचेतसः। शपन्तीष्टान् सखीनार्तास्तेभ्यः पापतरो नु कः॥
en: Who can in this world be more sinful than those, who from the grief at their son's death and thus becoming deprived of their sense, curse their dearest friends?

sa: गतेषु तेषु रक्षःसु भीमसेनात्मजेऽपि च। रहितान् भीमसेनेन कदाचित् तान् यदृच्छया।॥
en: And when those Rakshasas had all gone away as well as the son of Bhimasena (Ghatotkacha) and when Bhima had gone away to rove (on the mountain) at pleasure,

sa: मद्वाक्यं चावधार्याशु रामो राजीवलोचनः। स बुद्धिपूर्वं सैन्यस्य बद्ध्वा सेतुं महोदधौ।॥
en: Having heard everything from ine, the lotuseyed Rama fixed upon the course of his action and made with the help of his soldiers a bridge over the great ocean.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच ददासि चेद् वरं मह्यं वृणोमि भरतर्षभ। सर्वधर्मानुगः श्रीमानदासोऽस्तु युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Draupadi said O best of the Bharata race, if you grant me a boon, I say, let the handsome Yudhisthira, ever obedient to all duties, be freed from slavery.

sa: उपास्तीर्णा सभा राजन्नक्षानुप्त्वा युधिष्ठिर। एहि पाण्डव दीव्येति पिता त्वाऽऽहेति भारत॥
en: Pratikamin said O descendant of Bharata, your father has said, “O Yudhisthira, the assembly is ready. O son of Pandu, O king, O Yudhisthira, come and throw the dice.

sa: विपरीते तदा लोके पूर्वरूपं क्षयस्य तत्। बहवो म्लेच्छराजानः पृथिव्यां मनुजाधिप॥
en: O ruler of men, the course of the world then looks subverted, there are the signs of the universal dissolution. Then will rule over the earth many Mlechchha kings.

sa: वातं चाहूय मा शब्दमित्युवाच स तापसः। व्याहरंश्चेह पुरुषो मेघशब्देन वार्यते॥
en: That ascetic said, “Call the wind, so that no sound is made. Thus if a man utters a word here, he is prevented by the roarings of the clouds.

sa: निदेशात् ते महाराज गतोऽसौ भरतर्षभः। अर्जुनः पाण्डुपुत्राणां यस्मिन् प्राणाः प्रतिष्ठिताः॥
en: "O great king, this chief of the Bharata race Arjuna, has gone away in obedience to your command. On him depend the very lives of the sons of Pandu.

sa: अन्ये वै यजुषां लोकाः कर्मिणामपरे तथा। क्षमावतां ब्रह्मलोके लोकाः परमपूजिताः॥
en: Persons performing Vedic rites as well as those performing other rituals attain to other regions; whereas forgiving persons attain to the highly adored regions in the world of Brahma.

sa: अहं नारायणो नाम प्रभवः शाश्वतोऽव्ययः। विधाता सर्वभूतानां संहर्ता च द्विजोत्तम॥
en: O foremost of Brahmana, I am Narayana, the source of all things, the eternal, the unchangeable; I am the creator of all things and also the destroyer of all.

sa: लोमश उवाच निश्चयं तमभिज्ञाय मुनेस्तस्य महात्मनः। प्रतिवारणहेत्वर्थं बुद्ध्या संचिन्त्य बुद्धिमान्॥
en: Lomasha said: Having known the firın resolution of that high-souled Rishi, that intelligent deity (Indra) reflected (for a moment) and hit upon a means by which to dissuade him.

sa: उपयायाद्य शाल्वेन द्वारकां वृष्णिनन्दन। विषक्ते त्वयि दुर्धर्ष हतः शूरसुतो बलात्॥
en: O descendant of Vrishni race, O irrepressible hero, Shalva came to Dvarka in your absence and by main force he has killed the son of Sura (Vasudeva, Krishna's father).

sa: प्रतिजानीष्व तं कर्तुं ततो वेत्स्याम्यहं परम्। ततोऽहमब्रुवं राजन् देवराजमिदं वचः॥
en: Promise to pay it and then I shall tell you what you will have to do.” Thereupon, O king I said to the king of the gods these words:

sa: यावद् राम कथेयं ते भवेल्लोकेषु शत्रुहन्। तावज्जीवेयमित्येवं तथास्त्विति च सोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: I said, "O chastiser of foes, O Rama, let me live as long as the history of your deeds remains extant on earth. Thereupon he said, “So be it."

sa: रक्षितव्याः प्रजा राज्ञा तास्त्वं रक्षितुमर्हसि। निरुद्विग्नस्तपश्चर्तुं न हि शक्नोमि पार्थिव॥
en: O ruler of earth, the subjects should (always) be protected by the kings; you should therefore protect your people. I shall not be able to perform asceticism in peace.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच आकृष्यमाणे वसने द्रौपद्याश्चिन्तितो हरिः। गोविन्द द्वारकावासिन् कृष्ण गोपीजनप्रियः॥
en: When the cloth of Draupadi was being thus dragged, she thought of Hari. Draupadi said O Govinda, O dweller of Dwarika, O Krishna, O favourite of the milk maids,

sa: कुरुक्षेत्रसमा गङ्गा यत्र तत्रावगाहिता। विशेषो वै कनखले प्रयागे परमं महत्॥
en: Wherever a man bathes in the Ganges he obtains the fruits of going to Kurukshetra, except the place named Kanakhala while the merit attaching to Prayaga is the greatest.

sa: शुष्ककण्ठः पिपासातः पानीयार्थी भृशं नृपः। तं प्रविश्याश्रमं शान्तः पानीयं सोऽभ्ययाचत्॥
en: The king was suffering from thirst, his palate was dry and he was eagerly looking for water. Entering the hermitage, greatly tired as he was, he asked for water.

sa: येषां त्रीण्यवदातानि विद्या योनिश्च कर्म च। ते सेव्यास्तैः समास्या हि शास्त्रेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी। निरारम्भा ह्यपि वयं पुण्यशीलेषु साधुषु। पुण्यमेवाप्नुयामेह पापं पापोपसेवनात्॥
en: Those whose triple possessions, namely knowledge, birth and acts, are pure, should be waited upon. To associate with them is superior to the study of the Shastras. Without performing any special virtuous act, we shall be able to reap religious merits by associating with the righteous. We shall (assuredly) get sin by serving the sinful (Duryodhana and others).

sa: इच्छतां भूमिपालानां भीष्म जीवस्य संशयम्। लोकविद्विष्टकर्मा हि नान्योऽस्ति भवता समः॥
en: O Bhishma, surely you live at the pleasure of these kings. There is none else like you who is engaged in doing things contrary to the opinions of all.

sa: तां यौवनस्थां राजेन्द्र शतं कन्याः स्वलंकृताः। दास्यः शतं च कल्याणीमुपातस्थुर्वशानुगाः॥
en: O king of kings, when she grew youthful, one hundred damsels adorned with ornaments and also one hundred maid-servants, remaining at her command always, waited upon that blessed girl.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो वनगता: पार्थाः सायाह्ने सह कृष्णया। उपविष्टाः कथाश्चक्रुर्दुःखशोकपरायणाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon the sons of Pritha with Draupadi banished to the forest, sat one evening, stricken with grief and sorrow and began to talk with one another.

sa: दुर्गेषु च महाराज षट्स ये शास्त्रनिश्चिताः। सर्वदुर्गेषु मन्यन्ते नरदुर्गं सुदुस्तरम्॥
en: Among the six kinds of forts described in the scriptures, among every kind of other forts the service and the love of the subjects is of the most impregnable.

sa: तस्माद् राजैव कर्तव्यः सततं भूतिमिच्छता। न धनार्थो न दारार्थस्तेषां येषामराजकम्॥
en: For these reasons, men, seeking prosperity, should (elect and) crown some person as their king. They who live in countries where anarchy reigns cannot enjoy there wealth and wives.

sa: अपापो ह्येवमाचारः क्षिप्रं बहुमतो भवेत्। पापान्यपि हि कृच्छ्राणि शमयेन्नात्र संशयः॥
en: By behaving thus he may soon cleanse himself of his sins, and gain the high esteem of all. Forsooth, by such a conduct all his sins will be destroyed.

sa: त्रि:सप्तकृत्वो यः क्षत्रं धर्मव्युत्क्रान्तगौरवम्। क्रुद्धो निजघ्ने समरे तस्मै क्रौर्यात्मने नमः॥
en: In anger you had in battle, rooted out twenty-one times the Kshatriyas who had trodden virtue and authority under their feet, Salutations to you in your form of Cruelty.

sa: धात्रोपदिष्टं विषमं नूनं फलमसंस्कृतम्। यद् वयं त्वां जिघांसामस्त्वं चास्मान् कुरुसत्तम॥
en: Forsooth, this sad and woeful result had been ordained by the Creator himself, viz., that we should harm you and you should injure us, Oforemost one of Kuru's race!

sa: एकादशचमूनाथं कुरूणामधिपं तथा। मा स्पाक्षी म पादेन राजानं ज्ञातिमेव च॥
en: Duryodhana was the lord of eleven Akshauhinis of troops. He was the king of the Kurus! Do not, O Bhima, strike a king and a kinsman with your foot!

sa: धर्मान्वितेषु विज्ञाता मन्त्री गुप्तश्च पाण्डव। आप्तो राजा कुलीनश्च पर्याप्तो राजसंग्रह॥
en: That confident and high-born king who seeks instruction from learned and pious Brahmanas and who is protected by his ministers, can keep all his tributary chiefs under proper control.

sa: किं नु दुःखमतोऽन्यद् वै यदहं श्रमकर्शितः। भवतामाश्रमं प्राप्तो हताशो भ्रष्टलक्षणः॥
en: What can be more pitiable than this, viz., that I have arrived at this hermitage, exhausted with toil, shorn of the signs of royalty, and disappointed of my hopes.

sa: त्वया देवासुरे युद्धे वधार्थममरद्विषाम्। यथा साह्यं पुरा दत्तं हताश्च विबुधद्विषः॥
en: Formerly in the battle between the gods and। the Asuras, thou hadst, lent your help for the destruction of the foes of the celestials, and those enemies were killed.

sa: कथं विवरमद्राक्षीद् भीमसेनस्तवानघ। बलिनं कृतिनं नित्यं स च पापात्मवान् नृप॥
en: How then, O sinless one, could Bhima find any defect in you. You were ever powerful and skillful. He on the other hand, O king, is a wicked man.

sa: नमस्ते त्रिषु लोकेषु नमस्ते परतस्त्रिषु। योगेश्वर नमस्तेऽस्तु त्वं हि सर्वपरायणः॥
en: Salutations to you who are the three worlds and that are again above the three worlds. O lord of Yogins, salutations to you who are the refuge of all.

sa: एतद् दृष्टं मया राजंस्तथा च वचनं श्रुतम्। आशामपनयस्वाशु ततः कृशतरीमिमाम्॥
en: I saw all this, O king, and heard the words I have said. Dispell your hope that is even slenderer than any of those which the sage pointed out.

sa: यदि वापि समर्थः स्यास्त्वं दानाय सुयोधन। नाहमिच्छेयमवनिं त्वया दत्तां प्रशासितुम्॥
en: You may now, O Suyodhana, be willing to make a gift of Earth to me. I, however, do not wish to rule the Earth as a gift from you.

sa: अलंकारे च भोज्ये च तथा स्नानानुलेपने। हेलनानि नरव्याघ्र स्वस्थास्तस्योप शृण्वतः॥
en: If the king's jewels, or food, or the necessaries of his bath, or unguents, be not ready, the servants, in his very presence, do not display the least anxiety.

sa: जर्जरं चास्य विषयं कुर्वन्ति प्रतिरूपकैः। स्त्रीरक्षिभिश्च सज्जन्ते तुल्यवेषा भवन्ति च॥
en: They ruin the state with abuses by falsifications and forgeries. They make love with the female warders of the palace and dress in the same way as their master.

sa: प्रददौ सहदेवाय सततं प्रियकारिणे। मुमुदे तच्च लघ्वासौ कैलासं धनदो यथा।॥
en: The king gave it to Sahadeva who was ever busy with doing what was agreeable to him. Obtaining it, Sahadeva became pleased as the king treasures upon obtaining Kailasa.

sa: नातिक्रमिष्यते कृष्णो वचनं कौरवस्य तु। धृतराष्ट्रस्य मन्येऽहं नापि कृष्णस्य पाण्डवः॥
en: Krishna will not, I think, be able to disobey the words of Dhritarashtra of Kuru's race, nor will the son of Pandu be able to disregard those of Krishna.

sa: स तेषामनृणो भूत्वा गत्वा लोकेष्ववाच्यताम्॥ कृतकृत्योऽभवद् राजा प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्।
en: Thus satisfying the debt he owed to them and warding off the chance of censure in the world, the king became happy and began to protect his subjects virtuously.

sa: धनान्यपत्यं दाराश्च रत्नानि विविधानि च। पन्थानं पावकं हित्वा जनको मौढ्यमास्थितः॥
en: Leaving off wealth and children and wives and valuable possessions of all sorts and the established path for acquiring religious merit and fire itself, king Janaka shaved his head.

sa: यथैव ममत्राणां लोका: शस्त्रजिताः प्रभो। एवमस्यापि दुर्बुद्धेर्लोकाः शस्त्रेण वै जिताः॥
en: Like those gained by my sons, O powerful one, by the use of arms, this man too, however wicked-souled, has obtained many blissful regions by the use of weapons.

sa: छादयित्वा ततो बाणैः कर्णं प्रत्यस्यदर्जुनः। ततः कर्णः शितैर्बाणैा चिच्छेद सुतेजनैः॥
en: Then covering all the directions with arrows he struck Karna with many. Then with a number of whetted arrows of great power Karna sundered the string of Arjuna's bow.

sa: अर्थी तु शक्यते भोक्तुं कृतकार्योऽवमन्यते। तस्मात् सर्वाणि कार्याणि सावशेषाणि कारयेत्॥
en: A man who has many things to do, should not hesitatu to deal with even an ungrateful person. If successful, one can enjoy happiness. If unsuccessful, one loses respect.

sa: यस्त्वेतन्मन्यसे पार्थन ज्यायोऽस्ति धनादिति। तत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि यथा नैतत् प्रधानतः॥
en: Your conclusion, that there is nothing superior to wealth, is a mistake. I will convince you of it, so that you may not again regard wealth in that light.

sa: वरेण च्छन्द्यमानश्च ब्रह्मणा च पुनः पुनः। अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो वरयामास भारत॥
en: Brahma repeatedly asked him to ask for boons. At last the Rakshasa prayed for the boon, O Bharata, of being freed from fear of every being in the universe.

sa: प्रादुर्बभूवर्वैन्यस्य चिन्तनादेव पाण्डव। न जरा न च दुर्भिक्षं नाधयो व्याधयस्तथा॥
en: O son of Pandu, were born as soon as Vena's son thought of them. At that time there prevailed neither decrepitude, nor famine, nor calamity, nor disease (on Earth).

sa: ताडिता मद्रराजेन भीमस्य गदया गदा। दह्यमानेव खे राजन् साऽसृजत् पावकार्चिषः॥
en: Struck by the king of Madras with his mace, the mace of Bhima, O king, sent forth scintillations of fire in the sky which was as if on fire.

sa: उशना वेद यच्छास्त्रं यच्च देवगुरुर्द्विजः। तच्च सर्वं सवैयाख्यं प्राप्तवान् कुरुसत्तमः॥
en: That foremost one among the Kurus acquired a knowledge also of that science, with its interpretations, which Ushanas and the Rishi who is the preceptor of the celestials know.

sa: निवृत्तमनसं तस्मादभिप्रायाद् विचेतसम्। अहमामन्त्र्य संविग्नमश्वत्थामानमब्रुवम्॥ यः सदैव मनुष्येषु प्रमाणं परमं गतः। गाण्डीवधन्वा श्वेताश्वः कपिप्रवरकेतनः॥ यः साक्षाद् देवदेवेशं शितिकण्ठमुमापतिम्। द्वन्द्वयुद्धे पराजिष्णुस्तोषयामास शङ्करम्॥ यस्मात् प्रियतरो नास्ति ममान्यः पुरुषो भुवि। नादेयं यस्य मे किञ्चिदपि दारा: सुतास्तथा।॥ तेनापि सुहृदा ब्रह्मन् पार्थेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। नोक्तपूर्वमिदं वाक्यं यत् त्वं मामभिभाषसे॥
en: When he ceased cherishing that desire i addressed the anxious and senseless Ashvatthaman and said,-He who is always known as the best of all men that holder of Gandiva, that warrior having white horses yoked to his car, that hero having the emblem of a monkey of his standard, that hero who, desirous of defeating a wrestling encounter the god of gods, viz., the blue-throated lord of Uma, pleased the great Shankara himself, that Phalguna than whom I have no dearer friend on Earth, that friend to whom there is nothing that I cannot give including my very wives and children, that dear friend Partha of pure deeds, never said to me, O Brahmana, such words as these which you have said.

sa: स भवान् सर्वधर्मज्ञो धर्मात्मा भरतर्षभ। राजा मनीषी निपुणो लोके दृष्टपरावरः॥ त्यक्त्वा संतापजं शोकं दंशितो भव कर्मणि। क्षत्रियस्य विशेषेण हृदयं वज्रसंनिभम्॥
en: You know full well all duties, and you are of righteous soul, O foremost of Bharata's race. You are a wise king, of skilful deeds, You can discriminate what is right in this world from what is wrong. Shaking off this cheerlessness begotten by repentance engage in action vigorously. The heart of a Kshatriya is hard as adamant.

sa: कोशात् समुद्बबर्दाशु बिलाद् दीप्तमिबोरगम्। ततः खड्गवरं धीमान् भूताय प्राहिणोत् तदा॥
en: The intelligent son of Drona then threw that excellent scimitar at that being. approaching that being the weapon disappeared within his body like a mungoose disappearing in its hole.

sa: को हेतुर्यद् वशे तिष्ठेल्लोको दैवादृते गुणात्। विष्णोर्ललाटात् कमलं सौवर्णमभवत् तदा॥
en: What other cause can there be for which all men obey one person, save the divinity of the monarch? At that time a golden lotus sprang from Vishnu's brow.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः पुनः स गाङ्गेयमभिवाद्य पितामहम्। प्राञ्जलिर्नियतो भूत्वा पर्यपृच्छयुधिष्ठिरः॥ के धर्माः सर्ववर्णान्नां चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य के पृथक्। चातुर्वाश्रमाणां च राजधर्माश्च के मताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said After this Yudhishthira, saluted his grand father, the son of Ganga, and with joined hands and rapt attention, once more asked him, saying,-'What are the general duties of the four castes and what the especial duties of each. What mode of life should be adopted by which order and what duties are especially designated as the duties of kings.

sa: सम्यग् वेदान् प्राप्य शास्त्राण्यधीत्य सम्यग् राज्यं पालयित्वा महात्मा। चातुर्वर्ण्य स्थापयित्वा स्वधर्म वाजिग्रीवो मोदते देवलोके॥ जित्वा संग्रामान् पालयित्वा प्रजाश्च सोमं पीत्वा तर्पयित्वा द्विजाम्यान्। युक्त्या दण्डं धारयित्वा प्रजानां युद्धे क्षीणो मोदते देवलोके।॥
en: Having read the Vedas well and the other scriptures also, having governed his kingdom properly and made all the four orders follow their respective duties, the Hayagriva is sporting merrily in the regions of the celestials. Having gained many battles and cherished his subjects, having drunk the Soma juice in sacrifices and satisfied the foremost of Brahmanas with presents and judiciously held the rod of chastisement over those placed under his sway and at last sacrificed his life in battle, that king is living happily in heaven.

sa: अशस्त्रं क्षत्रियं मत्वा शस्त्रं गृह्णाद् यथापरः। त्राणायाप्यसमर्थं तं मन्यमानमतीव च॥
en: People of the other castes do take up arms if they see the Kshatriya not ready for fight, incompetent to protect himself, and too much afraid of the enemy.'

sa: कथं मित्रमरिं चापि विन्दते भरतर्षभ। चेष्टितव्यं कथं चात्र शत्रोमित्रस्य चान्तरे॥
en: How does a king at such times make friends and enemies? How should he, O foremost of Bharata's race, treat at such a time, both his friends and enemies?

sa: ततः सम्प्रेषयेद्राष्टे राष्ट्रीयाय च दर्शयेत्। अनेन व्यवहारेण द्रष्टव्यास्ते प्रजा: सदा॥
en: He should then announce in his kingdom, for the information of his subjects, the results of such consultations. You should always, following such a conduct, watch over your people.

sa: स्विष्टिः स्वधीतिः सुतपा लोकाञ्जयति यावतः। क्षणेन तानवाप्नोति प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्॥
en: A king, by only protecting his subjects virtuously, soon gains those regions that are acquired by persons leading duly the Garhasthya, the Brahmacharya, and the Vanaprastha modes of life.

sa: नैवापकारे कस्मिंश्चिदहं त्वयि तथा भवान्। उषितास्मि गृहेऽहं ते नेदानी विश्वसाम्यहम्॥
en: I never injured you, You also did never do me an injury. Therefore. I lived in your house. All that is changed, ind at present I cannot trust you.

sa: ये स्वधर्मादपेतेभ्यः प्रयच्छन्त्यल्पबुद्धयः। शतं वर्षाणि ते प्रेत्य पुरीषं भुञ्जते जनाः॥
en: Those foolish people who give away (wealth) to men who have neglected the duties of their order, have to live hereafter for a hundred years on ordure and dirt.

sa: शकुनिः सौबलो यत्र कैतव्यश्च महाबलः। निहत: सबलो वीरः किमन्यद् भागधेयतः॥
en: When Shakuni the son of Subala and the powerful Uluka, called the gamester's son, at the head of his forces, have been slain, what can it be but Destiny?

sa: तं ददौ सूर्यपुत्रस्तु मनुर्वे रक्षणार्थकम्। आनुपूर्व्याच्च दण्डोऽयं प्रजा जागर्ति पालयन्॥
en: Surya's son Manu gave the rod of punishment, (to his sons) for the protection of the world. Punishment in the hands of successive holders, remains awake, protecting all creatures.

sa: तत्र स्म नित्यं बध्यन्ते नक्तं बहुविधा मृगाः। कदाचिदत्र मार्जारस्त्वप्रमत्तो व्यबध्यत॥
en: Various sorts of animals fell into his traps nightly. And it so took place that one day the cat in a moment of carelessness was caught in the trap.

sa: कृत्स्ना मार्गगुणाश्चैव तथा भूमिगुणाश्च हा आत्मरक्षणमाश्वासः सर्गाणां चान्ववेक्षणम्॥ कल्पना विविधाश्चापि नृनागरथवाजिनाम्। व्यूहाश्च विविधाभिख्या विचित्रं युद्धकौशलम्॥ उत्पाताश्च निपाताश्च सुयुद्धं सुपलायितम्। शस्त्राणां पालनं ज्ञानं तथैव भरतर्षभ॥ बलव्यसनमुक्तं च तथैव बलहर्षणम्। पीडा चापदकालश्च पत्तिज्ञानं च पाण्डव॥ तथा खातविधानं च योगः संचार एव च। चोरैराटविकैश्चोग्रैः परराष्ट्रस्य पीडनम्॥ अग्निर्दैगरदैश्चैव प्रतिरूपककारकैः। श्रेणिमुख्योपजापेन वीरधश्छेदनेन च॥ दूषणेन च नागानामातङ्कजननेन च। आराधनेन
en: The various characteristics of roads (to follow), the nature of the soil on which to encamp, protection of self, superintendence of the construction of cars and other utensils of war and use, the various means for protecting and improving men, elephants, cars, and horses, the various kinds of arranging soldiers, strategies, and manoeuvres in war, planetary conjunctions indicating evil, evil auguries (such as earthquakes), skilful methods of warfare and retreat, knowledge of weapons and their proper care, the disorders of troops and how to get rid of them, the means of filling the army with joy and confidence, diseases, times of distress and danger, knowledge of guiding the infantry in battle, the methods of creating alarms and notifying orders, striking the enemy with fear by display of fl

sa: ततोऽनयत् कुञ्जरत्वं व्यानं तमृषिसत्तमः। महामेघनिभं दृष्ट्वा स भीतो ह्यभवद् गजः॥
en: Thereupon that foremost of sages transformed the tiger into an elephant. Seeing an animal of his own species, the real elephant, huge as a mass of clouds, became afraid.

sa: यतो हि सर्ववर्णानां यज्ञस्तस्यैव भारत। अग्रे सर्वेषु यज्ञेषु श्रद्धायज्ञो विधीयते॥
en: Sacrifice, O Bharata, has been as much sanctioned for the Shudra as for the three other orders. Of all sacrifices, devotion has been laid down to be the foremost.

sa: छिन्धि भिन्धीति यः शब्दः श्रुयते वाहिनीमुखे॥ सामानि सामगास्तस्य गायन्ति यमसादने।
en: 'Cut, Pierce,' and such other sounds, that are heard in the front ranks of the army, are the Samans sung by its Vedic chanters in the abode of Yama.

sa: अभिनीतानि शस्त्राणि योधाश्च कृतनिश्चयाः। चैत्र्यां वा मार्गशीर्थ्यां वा सेनायोगः प्रशस्यते॥
en: The weapons should all be properly whetted. The soldiers should be filled with courage and resolution. It is proper to march the troops in the month of Chaitra Agrahayana.

sa: ये गुप्ताश्चैव दुर्गाश्च देशास्तेषु प्रवेशयेत्। धनिनो बलमुख्यांश्च सान्त्वयित्वा पुनः पुनः॥
en: Giving repeated assurances to his wealthy subjects and the principal officers of the army, he should make the dwellers of the open country to take refuge in well-protected forts.

sa: एवं विचिन्तयामास मूषिकः शत्रुचेष्टितम्॥ ततोऽर्थगतितत्त्वज्ञः संधिविग्रहकालवित्। सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वाक्यं मार्जारं मूषिकोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Having thought thus, the mouse, well-read in the science of Profit and well-acquainted with times when war should be declared and peace made, gently spoke to the cat, saying,

sa: शिबिमौशीनरं चैव मृतं सुंजय शुश्रुम॥ य इमां पृथिवीं सर्वां चर्मवत्समवेश्यत्।
en: We hear also, O Srinjaya, that Shivi the son of Ushinara, met with death. That king governed the entire Earth as one holds, the leathern shield in his hand.

sa: यत्तु लिङ्गान्तरगतं पृच्छसे मां युधिष्ठिर। धर्मं धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठ तन्निबोध नराधिप॥
en: O foremost of virtuous persons, hear now what you ask viz., the merit that a king acquires when the duties are practised by others leading other modes of life.

sa: आहरन्ति नरश्रेष्ठास्तेषां लोकेष्वपश्यत। सर्वमेधं त दुष्प्रापं तथा सौत्रामणिं च ये॥
en: Indeed, Devala saw Jaigishavya in the regions also of those that celebrate the sacrifice called Sautramani and that other in which the flesh of all living animals is required.

sa: केवलं दृष्ट्वा प्रपातं नानुपश्यति। स भ्रष्टो मधुलोभेन शोचत्येवं यथा भवान्॥
en: The man who always looks at the honey without seeing the fall, meets with destruction through his covetousness for honey. Such a man is obliged to repent like yourself.

sa: शत्रोरनार्यभूतस्य क्लिष्टस्य क्षुधितस्य च॥ भक्ष्यं मृगयमाणस्य कः प्राज्ञो विषयं व्रजेत्।
en: What sane man will place himself under the power of an enemy who is not well-known for virtue, who is hungry, and who is in search of a prey?

sa: एवं ते वर्तमानस्य लोके कीर्तिर्भविष्यति। धर्मार्थः सुमहांस्तात तप्तं स्याच तपश्चिरात्॥
en: If you live thus, you fame will travel all over the world. You will then acquire a knowledge of all duties and find many years for acquiring ascetic merit.

sa: सिंहस्य सततं पार्वे सिंह एवानुगो भवेत्। असिंहः सिंहसहितः सिंहवल्लभते फलम्॥
en: A lion should always associate with a lion, If one that is not a lion associates with a lion, it acquires all the advantages that belong to a lion.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवो दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रिताः। म्लेच्छाचार्याश्च राजानः प्राच्योदीच्यास्तथैव च॥
en: Besides these, many others who lived in the Deccan and many preceptors of the Mlechchha tribes, and many kings from the East and the North, O Bharata, came there.

sa: तमत्वरन्तं पलितं पाशानां छेदने तथा। संचोदयितुमारेभे मार्जारो मूषिकं तदा॥ किं सौम्य नातित्वरसे किं कृतार्थोऽवमन्यसे। छिन्धि पाशानमित्रघ्न पुरा श्वपच एति च॥
en: Seeing the mouse so slow in the work, the cat wishing to hurry it on, said-How is it, O amiable one, that you do not proceed quickly with your work? Do you disregard me now, having accomplished your own work? O slayer of foes, cut off these strings quickly! The hunter will soon come hereइत्युक्तस्त्वरता तेन मतिमान् पलितोऽब्रवीत्।

sa: समासाद्य तु पाण्डुनामनीकानि सहस्रशः। द्रोणेन चरता संख्ये प्रभग्नानि शितैः शरैः।॥
en: Meanwhile the Pandava hosts' having reached by thousands Drona who had been coursing through the field of battle became shattered and broken with the sharp shafts of the latter.

sa: पुरा चैवापराधेन वधेन च चमूपतेः। मन्ये मनः प्रजज्वाल पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: I have no doubt that in consequence of the wrongs they suffered before, and in consequence of the death of their general, the hearts of the Pandavas blazed up.

sa: पृष्ठे कलिङ्गः साम्बष्ठा मागधाः पौण्ड्रमद्रकाः॥ गान्धाराः शकुनाः प्राच्याः पर्वतीया वसातयः।
en: The Kalingas, the Ambasthas, the Magadhas, the Paundras, the Madrakas, the Gandharas, the Sakunas, the Easterners, the highlanders and the Vasatis were stationed in the back of that Suparna.

sa: यावान् भूम्यवकाशोऽयं दृश्यते शशलक्षणे। तस्य प्रमाणं प्रब्रूहि ततो वक्ष्यसि पिप्पलम्॥
en: Tell us now of the dimension of that portion of the land that looks like a hare. You may then describe the portion that looks like the pipal tree.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्न उवाच द्रोणस्य यतमानस्य वशं नैष्यसि सुव्रत। अहमावारयिष्यामि द्रोणमद्य सहानुगम्॥
en: Dhrishtadyumna said O you of chaste vows, you shall never be subjugating by Drona however much he may strive. Today I myself will resist Drona and all his followers.

sa: शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया। आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किंचिदपि चिन्तयेत्॥
en: One should, by slow degrees, cease of think the objects of senses, with the. help of his understanding and controlled by patience, and then directing his mind to self.

sa: नावहास्याः कथं लोके कर्मणानेन संयुगे। भवेम सहिताः सर्वे निवर्तध्वं यथाबलम्॥
en: Will we not be the objects of derision in this world, for this (cowardly) act of ours in battle? United together, do you again repair to your own divisions?'

sa: इत्युब्रुवन् महाराज रणे द्रोणेन पीडिताः॥ वर्तमाने तथा रौद्रे संग्रामे भरतर्षभ।
en: Even these were the words that the sons of Pritha said, O monarch, when o foremost of the Bharatas, they were greatly afflicted by him in that fierce fight.

sa: आविद्ध्यतो गदां तस्य कौन्तेयस्य महात्मनः। बभौ रूपं महाघोरं कालस्येव युगक्षये॥
en: The appearance of that high-souled son of Kunti, as he whirled his mace, became as terrible as that of the Destroyer himself at the time of the universal destruction.

sa: निमित्ते दूरपातित्वे लघुत्वे दृढवेधने। मम ब्रवीतु भगवान् विशेष फाल्गुनस्य च॥
en: “Tell me, O illustrious one, the difference between myself and Phalguna, as regards hitting the aim, hitting it from a distance, lightness of hands and the force of strokes.

sa: नैव स्थापयितुं शक्या शूरैरपि महाचमूः। सत्कृत्य महतीं सेनां चतुरङ्गां महीपतिः।
en: O king, when an army is routed, even brave leaders at the head of large divisions of the army consisting of four kinds of troops can not rally them.

sa: तेषां त्रयाणां चापानिचिच्छेद विशिखैस्त्रिभिः। ते निकृत्तायुधाः शूरा निर्विषा भुजगा इव॥
en: Then with their bows severed, those warriors with three darts appeared like serpents without venom. Then from their respctive cars, hurling lances at the foe, they uttered loud warcries.

sa: ब्रवीम्येतत् क्लीववत् त्वां युद्धादन्यत् किमिच्छसि। योत्स्येऽहं कौरवस्यार्थे तवाशास्यो जयो मया॥ जपमाशास्व ब्रह्मन् मन्त्रयस्व च यद्धितम्। युद्ध्यस्व कौरवस्यार्थे वर एष वृतो मया॥
en: It is for this like a cunuch I am telling you the following-“Battle excepted what do you wish to get” I shall fight on behalf of the Kurus; but I shall pray for your victory. O Brahmana, pray for my victory and advise me what is good to me. Fight for the Kurus. This is the boon I ask from you.

sa: तं तु शोकेन संतप्तं स्वप्ने कपिवरध्वजम्। आससाद महातेजा ध्यायन्तं गरुडध्वजः॥
en: Then the highly puissant god having the Garuda as an emblem on his banner, appeared before the ape-bannered Arjuna merged in thought and burning with grief, in his dream.

sa: कुरूणां सृञ्जयानां च जिगीषूणां परस्परम्। सिंहानामिव संह्रादो दिवमुर्वी च नादयन्॥
en: Desiring victory in battle, the loud shouts that the Kurus and the Srinjayas made, resembling those of so many lions, caused the earth and the sky to be resounded.

sa: योगीनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना। श्रद्धावाम्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः॥
en: Even amongst all Yogis, he who being full of faith, worships Me with his inmost self being intent on Me, is considered by Me, to be the most devout.

sa: त्वया चैव नरश्रेष्ठ तन्मे प्रीत्यानुमोदितम्। पुत्रकर्म कृतं चैव कन्यायाः पार्थिवर्षभ॥
en: O best of men, you had, also, from love of me, corroborated it and O best among kings, the rites belonging to a son were performed for this daughter.

sa: यथा प्राग्ज्योतिषो राजा गजेन मधुसूदन। त्वरमाणो विनिष्क्रान्तो ध्रुवं तस्यैष नि:स्वनः॥
en: O slayer of Madhu, as the ruler of the Pragjyotisas has advanced with impetuosity to the battle, riding on his elephant, this loud noise may be attributed to him.

sa: स तु गोवासनः शैव्यः सहितः सर्वराजभिः। ययौ मातङ्गराजेन राजाहेण पताकिना।
en: Shaivya, the ruler of the Govasanas accomplished by the chiefs marched on a great elephant worthy to be used by kings. It had a banner flying from its back.

sa: धर्मेण सर्वकार्याणि आरभनते सदा पार्थाः जीवितादीनि भारत प्रार्थयाना महद् यशः॥
en: The sons of Pritha, O Bharata, desirous of securing illustrious fame, ever perform all acts, even the maintenance of their lives, in perfect accordance with the rulers of morality.

sa: शिखण्ड्यपि महाराज पुंवद् राजकुले तदा। विजहार मुदा युक्तः स्त्रीत्वं नैवातिरोचयन्॥
en: And, O great king, Shikhandin also at that time conducted himself like a male at the royal court with great joy, setting aside as it were his feminine nature.

sa: भुक्ष्वेमां पृथिवीं राजन् भ्रातृभिः सहितः सुखी। दुर्हदस्तापयन् सर्वान् नन्दयंश्चापि बान्धवान्॥
en: Do you, O king, enjoy the blessings of this earth with your brothers, with a contented heart, and enhancing the delight of your relatives and gratifying every one else.

sa: अमर्षं राज्यहरणं वनवासं च पाण्डव। द्रौपद्याश्च परिक्लेशं संस्मरन् पुरुषो भव॥
en: Remembering, O son of Pandu, the pain of being exiled from your kingdom and of your residence in the forth and the trouble endued by Krishna, be a man.

sa: सापह्नवाः सदैवासन् पाण्डवाः पाण्डुपूर्वज। न चैतान् बहु मन्यन्ते पुत्रास्तव विशाम्पते॥
en: O elder brother of Pandu, the sons of Pandu tried always to keep them 'hidden and unknown. O ruler of men your sons do not pay them proper respect.

sa: सैन्धवाय च वार्ष्णेयं युयुधानं समादिशत्। शिखण्डिनं च भीष्माय प्रमुख समकल्पयत्॥
en: And he appointed Yuyudhana of the Vrishini race to fight with the king of the Sindhus and also appointed Shikhandin to be in the front for fighting with Bhishma.

sa: सोऽभवद् द्वादशसमो द्वादशाहेन वीर्यवान्। इमं च पृथिवीं कृत्स्नामेकाहा स व्यजीजयत्॥
en: In twelve days he became twelve cubits in stature and was also endued with great prowess. And he conquered this extensive earth in the course of a single day.

sa: मुञ्चेयं यदि वास्त्राणि महान्ति समरे स्थितः। शतसाहिस्रघातीनि हन्यां मासेन भारत॥
en: But if I shoot my mighty weapons I can slay (at once) hundreds and thousands; being stationed in battle, I can slay (the army) in a month, O Bharata.

sa: भीष्म उवाच निष्क्रामन्ती तु नगराच्चिन्तयामास दुःखिता। पृथिव्यां नास्ति युवतिर्विषमस्थतरा मया॥
en: Bhishma said As she sorrowfully issued out of the capital she thought within herself: “In this world there is no young woman in a more difficult situation than myself.

sa: किमर्थमेतन्नाख्यातं त्वया कृष्ण रणे मम॥ अधाक्षं तानहं क्रूरांस्तदा सर्वान् महारथान्।
en: Why, O Krishna, did you not tell me all this in the course of fight? I would then have burnt down all those cruel car-warriors of the enemy's host.

sa: न बिना नायकं सेना मुहूर्तमपि तिष्ठति। आहवेष्वाहवश्रेष्ठ नेतृहीनेव नौ ले॥
en: Like an unmanned boat in waters, the army cannot stand in battle even for a short while without a leader, O Karna, O you who are foremost in battle.

sa: संजय उवाच गतपूर्वाह्नभूयिष्ठे तस्मिन्नहनि भारत। पश्चिमां दिशमास्थाय स्थिते चापि दिवाकरे॥
en: Sanjaya said O descendant of Bharata, when the morning of that day passed away and when the sun in his westward course had gone some portion of his path.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच कैर्लिङ्गैस्त्रीन् गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो। किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन् गुणानतिवर्तते॥
en: Arjuna said What are the characteristic, O Lord, of that man who has transcended the three qualities? What is his conduct? How can a man transcend these three qualities?

sa: स्त्रीभावेन च मे गाढं मनः शान्तमुमापते। प्रतिश्रुतश्च भूतेश त्वया भीष्मपराजयः॥
en: O lord of Uma, my mind is perfectly calm, so far as regards a woman. And you have also promised, O lord of all creatures, the defeat of Bhishma.

sa: पराक्रमः परा शक्त्या तत् तु तस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठितम्। अनीकानि विनिघ्नन्तं ह्रीमन्तमपराजितम्॥ कथं शान्तनवं तात पाण्डुपुत्रा न्यवारयन्। कथं युक्तान्यनीकानि कथं युद्धं महात्मभिः॥
en: The display of prowess and the great strength has been considered to be the duty of a Kshatriya. How did the Pandavas oppose my father Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, that invincible but modest hero when he was destroying the troops of the enemy? How were the troops arranged and how did he fight with the illustrious enemies?

sa: ब्रह्मवक्त्राय सर्वाय शङ्कराय शिवाय च। नमोऽस्तु वाचस्पतये प्रजानां पतये नमः॥
en: Salutations be unto him who is the lord of speech and the master of the created beings; salutation unto the lord of the universe and of the great people.

sa: निशम्य वचनं तस्य चरणावभिवाद्य च। ययौ वैकर्तनः कर्णः समीपं सर्वधन्विनाम्॥
en: Having heard these words of him (Bhishma) and having bowed down to his feet, Karna, the son of Vikartana, went to the place where all the bowmen were assembled.

sa: यच्छिखण्डिमुखाः सर्वे पाण्डवा भीष्ममभ्ययुः। कच्चित् ते कुरवः सर्वे नाजहुः संजयाच्युतम्॥
en: O Sanjaya, when all the Pandavas with Shikhandin at their head advanced against Bhishma, I hope the Kurus stood by the side of the great hero of immeasurable prowess.

sa: अग्निवर्णा यथा भासः शस्त्राणामुदकस्य च। कवचानां ध्वजानां च भविष्यति महाक्षयः॥
en: The shine of weapons, of the water, of the armours and of the standards looks like fire. A great slaughter of men and beasts is sure to take place.

sa: स तन्न मसृषे वीरः शत्रोर्विक्रममाहवे। ततोऽस्य गदया दान्तान् हयान् सर्वानपातयत्॥
en: But the latter did not tolerate that act of prowess achieved by his adversary in battle; and then with his mace he felled the excellently trajned horses of Vivinsati.

sa: वसुधोवाच दुहितृत्वेन मां वीर संकल्पयितुमर्हसि। तथेत्युक्वा पृथुः सर्वे विधानमकरोद् वशी॥
en: The Earth said "O Hero, it behoves you to look upon me as your own daughter." Saying, “So be it” the self-controlled Prithu, then arranged for (milking the Earth).

sa: शितैस्तु बहुशो राजंस्तं च विव्याध पत्रिभिः। शिखण्डी तु ततः खङ्गं खण्डितं तेन सायकैः॥ आविध्य व्यसृजत् तूर्णं ज्वलन्तमिव पन्नगम्। तमापतन्तं सहसा कालानलसमप्रभम्॥
en: The O monarch he (Drona's son) pierced Shikhandin with myriad's of shafts furnished with wings. Thereat Shikhandin whirling the fragment of his sword splintered by the arrows (of Drauni), hurled it at the latter, like a blazing serpent. Beholding that fragment of the sword that then resembled the all destructive fire (at the end of a Yuga) come swiftly toward himself.

sa: संजय उवाच सैन्धवेन निरुद्धेषु जयगृद्धिषु पाण्डुषु। सुघोरमभवद्युद्धं त्वदीयानां परैः सह॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus when the Pandavas intent on securing victory were resisted by the Sindhu ruler, there commenced an awful fight between your Warriors and those of the enemy.

sa: न प्रमाणस्थितिहस्ति तिष्येऽस्मिन् भरतर्षभ। गर्भस्थाश्च म्रियन्तेऽत्र तथा जाता म्रियन्ति च॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, in Kali there will be no fixed period for men's life on earth, they will die even in the womb or after birth.

sa: युद्धं तु मे न रुचितं ज्ञातिभिर्मधुसूदन। संचोदय हयाशीघ्रं धार्तराष्ट्रचमूं प्रति॥
en: But, O slayer of Madhu, this battle with my kinsmen does not at all please me. However, swiftly drive the horses towards the army of the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sa: चिच्छेद तन्महन्छूलं तेन बाणेन वेगवान्। उत्पपात द्विधा च्छिन्नं शूलं हेमपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: Then with that arrow, that hero endued with energy, cut off the fierce trident; and that trident of golden effulgence then fell down on the ground divided in twain,

sa: भीष्मो वसूनामन्यतमो दिष्ट्या जीवसि पुत्रका गाङ्गेयः शान्तनोः पुत्रो वसुरेष महायशाः॥
en: Bhishma is one of the foremost of the Vasus. It is only by good luck that you are still living. This Shantanu's son by Ganga is a celebrated Vasu,

sa: न हि भीष्मं दुराधर्षं व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम्। त्वदन्यः शक्नुयाद् योद्धमपि वज्रधरः स्वयम्॥
en: Except yourself, O invincible one, none including the wielder of the thunder bolt himself will be able to fight with Bhishma who resembles Death himself with wide open mouth.

sa: दृष्ट्वा च पाण्डवो भ्रातृन् युध्यमानान् महारथान्। त्वरितो भरतश्रेष्ठ तत्रायुध्यत् किरञ्छरान्॥
en: Beholding his brothers, all mighty carwarriors, thus engaged in battle, that son of Pandu (Arjuna), O foremost of the Bharatas, joined the fight scattering his shafts on all sides.

sa: हताश्वे तु रथे तिष्ठन् भीमसेनो महाबलः॥ शक्रदेवाय चिक्षेप सर्वशैक्यायसीं गदाम्।
en: But the greatly strong Bhima stayed on that car, the horses of which had been killed. He hurled from it at Shakradeva a mace made of the hardest iron.

sa: सरोऽसृतमयं दिव्यमभ्याशे शत्रुसूदनौ। तत्र मे तद् धनुर्दिव्यं शश्च निहितः पुरा॥
en: You slayers of foes, there is a heavenly lake of nectar not far from this place; in days gone by, I laid down my celestial bow and arrows there.

sa: स राज्ञा स्वयमाचार्यो भृशमत्रार्थितोऽर्जुन। संविधानं च विहितं रथाश्च किल सज्जिताः॥
en: O Arjuna, thus addressed the king himself entreated the preceptor to undertake to protect Jayadratha. All remedial measures have been adopted; and chariots and steeds have been duly arranged.

sa: तेषां जवेनापततां भीष्मः शान्तनवो रणे। पाञ्चाल्यं त्रिभिरानछेत् सात्यकिं नवभिः शरैः॥
en: As they were rushing upon him with great impetuosity, the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, in that great battle, wounded the Panchala prices with three arrows and Satyaki with nine.

sa: ते प्रसुप्ते बले तत्र परिश्रान्तजने नृप। हस्त्यश्वबहुले रात्रौ प्रेक्षणीये बभूवतुः॥
en: When those two armies, abounding in elephants and steeds and men exhausted with fatigue, were lulled in the arms of sleep O king, they, indeed presented a charming sight.

sa: द्रोण उवाच बालिशस्त्वं न जानीषे पाण्डवानां पराक्रमम्। न शक्या हि यथा जेतुं पाण्डवा हि महाबलाः॥ यथाबलं यथावीर्यं कर्म कुर्यामहं हि ते।
en: It is undoubtedly true that we are ambitious of subjugating the gods too by giving them defeat in battle-field if escorted by you and grandfather Bhishma. Again, it is not anyway a big mission to conquer Pandavas who already are devoid of power and valour both. Be it for all good to you. Do an attempt viable to kill all Pandavas.

sa: पिनाकी सर्वभूतेशो भगनेत्रनिपातनः। ते गत्वा सहिता देवा ब्राह्मणा सह मन्दरम्॥
en: That wielder of the Pinaka, that lord of all creatures, that slayer of the Asura that Bhaganetra. Thereupon all those celestials accompanied by Brahma, proceeded to the Mandara mountain.

sa: त एव मां महाराज स्वप्नदर्शनमेत्य वै। परिवार्याब्रुवन् वाक्यं तन्निबोध कुरूद्वह॥
en: Even they, O great king, showing themselves to me (during my sleep) in a dream, stood around me, and spoke these words; Hear them, O perpetuator of Kuru's race,

sa: तथेत्युक्त्वा गता देवी कृतकामा मनस्विनी। स चाप्यासीद् दुराधर्षो नरकः शत्रुतापनः॥
en: Then saying “Be it so", that intelligent goddess went away, satisfied at the fruition of her desire. Her son Naraka, that afflicter of hostile horses, also accordingly became invincible.

sa: अर्जुनस्य सुतः श्रीमानिरावान् नाम वीर्यवान्। स्नुषायां नागराजस्य जातः पार्थेन धीमता॥
en: This prosperous son of Arjuna by name Iravat, endued with great prowess was begotten by the highly intelligent Partha (Arjuna) on the daughter of the sovereign of the Nagas.

sa: नानाविधैश्च शस्त्रौघैः पात्यमानैर्महारणे। न संधिः शक्यते भेत्तुं वर्मबन्धस्य तस्य तु॥
en: Although then in that dreadful battle myriads of weapons of diverse description were hurled at him, yet they could not slacken or pierce through the joints, of that armour.

sa: व्याष्य कृत्स्नं जगत् कीर्त्या सुरर्षिगणसेवितः। स प्राप्य विधिवद् राज्यं सर्वभूतानुकम्पकः॥
en: That one (Rama), served even by the Gods and the sages, filled the earth with his fame. Having acquired immeasurable kingdom, he used to treat his subjects with kindness.

sa: संक्षेपो वर्तते राजन् द्वापरेऽस्मिन् नराधिप। गुणोत्तरं हैमवतं हरिवर्षं ततः परम्॥
en: O king, O ruler of men, the portion of the Dvapara Yuga that still remains is very small. The Varsha called Haimavat is superior to Harivarsha in all attributes.

sa: ततो भीमो महावाहुर्विरथो रथिनां वरः। गदां प्रगृह्य वेगेन प्रचस्कन्द रथोत्तमात्॥
en: Then O mighty monarch, that foremost of car-warriors Bhima, thus deprived of the use of his car, quickly leapt off from his excellent chariot with a mace in hand.

sa: तान् सकुञ्जरपत्त्यश्वान् प्राहिणोद् यमसादनम्। चक्रेऽचिरेण च द्रोणो महीं शोणित कर्दमाम्॥
en: Then he began to dispatch them with their elephants, steeds and foot-soldiers to the regions of Death; and within a short while Drona made the earth muddy with blood.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच भारद्वाजेन भग्नेषु पाण्डवेषु महामृधे। पञ्चालेषु च सर्वेषु कच्चिदन्योऽभ्यवर्तत॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When in that fierce fight, the son of Bharadvaja had shattered the host of the Pandavas and the Panchalas, did any one else approach him for battle?

sa: ततोऽहं विप्रमुख्यैस्तैर्यैरस्मि पतितो रथात्। उत्थापितो धृतश्चैव मा भैरिति च सान्त्वितः॥
en: Those foremost of Brahmanas by whom I had been raised up when I had fallen down from chariot, and who had held me and comforted me, saying, “Fear not.”

sa: सेनापतित्वं सम्प्राप्य भारद्वाजो महारथः। मध्ये सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य पुत्रं ते वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: The mighty car-warrior, the of Bharadvaja, having been installed as the commander of the army, said these words to your son, in the very midst of the soldiers. son

sa: अभेद्यमस्य कवचं युवा चाशुपराक्रमः। उपदिष्टा मया चास्य पितुः कवचधारणा॥ तामेष निखिला वेत्ति ध्रुवं परपुरंजयः। शक्यं त्वस्य धनुश्छेत्तुं ज्यां च बाणैः समाहितैः।।२८
en: "O Karna! This Abhimanyu is faithful, his prowess is great and his armour is incapable of being penetrated into. I have taught the father of this hero, the diverse methods of wearing coats of mail; assuredly this subjugator of hostile fortresses, knows all those methods of wearing armours. But exerting yourself carefully, you can, with arrows cut-off his bow, his bowstring.

sa: खङ्गमादाय सुशितं विमलं च शरावरम्। श्येनवद् व्यचरत् क्रुद्धः शिखण्डी शत्रुतापनः॥
en: Grasping a whetted and effulgent sword and buckler. Then that afflicter of foes, namely Shikhandin, waxing wroth began to move about on the field of battle like a hawk.

sa: तस्य पुत्रो हि भगवन् भीष्मद्रोणमुखै रथैः। पराजित्य महेष्वासान् पाण्डवान् राज्यमिच्छति॥
en: His son, O worshipful one, desired to obtain monarchy after having defeated the mighty warriors, the sons of Pandu, through the assistance of Bhima, Drona and other such heroes.

sa: संजय उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा महाराज भारद्वाजस्य धीमतः। अनुमान्य तमाचार्य प्रायाच्छारद्वतं प्रति॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, having heard these words of the wise son of Bharadvaja and also having honoured the preceptor, he (Yudhishthira) went towards the son of Sharadvata (Kripa).

sa: तथैव चरतो मार्गान् मण्डलानि च सर्वशः। महाविद्युत्प्रतीकाशा शल्यस्य शुशुभे गदा॥
en: Similarly, the mace was getting grace like lightening in the hands of king Shalya when it was being played in orbits, circles and several trends as prescribed for truncheon-war.

sa: स करी भगदत्तेन प्रेर्यमाणो मुहुर्मुहुः। न करोति वचस्तस्य दरिद्रस्येव योषिता॥
en: Then like the wife of a poor man, refusing to carry out the orders of her husband, that elephant though often urged by Bhagadatta, refused to obey his orders.

sa: आज्ञापय कुरुश्रेष्ठ सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वर। प्रेष्योऽहं तव दुर्धर्ष क्रियतां किं पितामह॥
en: Command me, O foremost of the Kurus, O chief of all wielders of weapons. I am your slave, O invincible one. What, O grandsire, shall I do for you.

sa: गौतमं ताडयामास शरैर्बहुभिराहवे॥ सैन्धवस्य तथाश्वांश्च सारथिं च त्रिभिः शरैः। प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय कालान्तकसमद्युतिः॥ हताश्वात् तु रथात् तूर्णमवप्लुत्य महारथः। शरांश्चिक्षेप निशितान् भीमसेनस्य संयुगे॥
en: And he pierced the son of Gautami with numerous arrows in battle. Then with three arrows, that one of effulgence like that of the Destroyer himself dispatched to the regions of Death, the steeds and driver of the ruler of the Sindhus. Then that mighty car-warrior quickly jumping down from the car, the steed of which were slain,

sa: लोकस्तं वेद यदहं पितुः प्रियचिकीर्षया। प्राप्तं राज्यं परित्यज्य ब्रह्मचर्यव्रते स्थितः॥
en: The word knows the fact that I desirous of doing what was agreeable to my father, abandoned a kingdom which I had obtained and observed the vow of Brahmacharya.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच प्रजहाति यदा कामान् सर्वान् पार्थ मनोगतान्। आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते॥
en: The Great One said “When a man, O Partha, abandons all his mental desires, and becomes pleased in his self by his own self, is called one of Steady-mind.

sa: न स भीष्मो महाबाहुर्मामिच्छति विशाम्पते। भ्रातृहेतोः समारम्भो भीष्मस्येति श्रुतं मया॥
en: That Bhishma of long arms does not want me, O lord of the universe and this exertion of Bhishma is for the sake of his brother, I have heard.

sa: विद्याशूरं तप:शूरं दानशूरं तपस्विनम्। ब्राह्मया श्रिया दीप्यमानं साधुवादे च सम्मतम्॥
en: Who is a hero in knowledge, a hero in devotion, a hero in liberality, a performer of austerities blazing with Brahmic prosperity and honored in speeches of the honest,

sa: पिता राजा च वृद्धश्च सर्वथा मानमर्हति। तस्मान्मान्यश्च पूज्यश्च धृतराष्ट्रो जनार्दन॥
en: It is proper that the father, the king and the aged should be treated always with respect; therefore is Dhritarashtra the object of our worship and respect, O Janardana.

sa: नाहमेतत् करिष्यामि गच्छध्वं वै सुरोत्तमाः। अस्मिंश्चार्थं पुरा गीतं ब्रह्मणा श्रुयतामिदम्॥
en: I shall not do this; go, you best among the gods; listen to what has before been sung by Brahma, with regard to this matter, in days of old.

sa: सुवृत्तो भव राजेन्द्र पाण्डवान् प्रति मानद। अधर्षणीयः शत्रूणां तैर्वृतस्त्वं भविष्यसि॥
en: O chief among kings, you act like one leading virtuous life, towards the Pandavas. O you giver of honours, surrounded by them you will be unconquerable by your enemies.

sa: गन्धर्वैर्घोषयात्रायां ह्रियते यत् सुतस्तव। क्व तदा सूतपुत्रोऽभूद् य इदानीं वृषायते॥
en: When your son was being taken as a captive towards the Ghoshayatra by the Gandharvas, where was then the son of Suta who is now roaring like a bull.

sa: सोऽहं भगवती याचे प्रणतः प्रियकाम्यया। मयैतन्नाम प्रध्यातं मनसा शोचता किल॥
en: I now pray this goddess for my own good with my head bowed down: I have harbored this thought in my mind and have come to grief consequence thereof.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच देवराजमनुप्राप्तं ब्राह्मणच्छद्मना वृतम्। दृष्ट्वा स्वागतमित्याह न बुबोधास्य मानसम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Beholding the king of the celestials disguised as a Brahmana come (to him), (Karna) said "you are right welcome.” But he could not divine his intentions.

sa: स च पश्यतु देवेन्द्रो दुरात्मा पापचेतनः। उपस्पृश्य ततः क्रुद्धस्तपस्वी सुमहायशाः॥
en: Let the chief of the gods also see it who is vile and of a vicious nature. Then the wrathful devotee of very great fame having performed his ablutions.

sa: ते निकृत्ताः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्यपतन् धरणीतले। तमङ्गदो वालिसुतः श्रीमानुद्यम्य पादपम्॥ अभिद्रुत्य महावेगस्ताडयामास मूर्धनि। तस्येन्द्रजिदसम्भ्रान्तः प्रासेनोरसि वीर्यवान्॥ प्रहर्तुमैच्छत् तं चास्य प्रासं चिच्छेद लक्ष्मणः।
en: (Thus) cut down by sharpened darts they fell down on earth. Then the renowned Angada, the son to Bali, uprooting a tree and coming up with great speed, struck him (Indrajita) on the head. (But) the mighty Indrajita 'nothing daunted at this, took up a lance (and) wished to hurl it at him. (But) Lakshmana severed that lance.

sa: तादृशे हि कुले जाता कुले चैव विवर्धिता। सुखात् सुखमनुप्राप्ता ह्रदाद्धदमिवागता।॥
en: Born in such a line and brought up in this race, you have like a lotus, transferred from one lake to another, attained to one blissful state from another.

sa: न हतुष्टो जनोऽस्तीह पुरे चान्तःपुरे च ते। सम्यग्वृत्त्यानवद्याङ्गि तव भृत्यजनेष्वपि॥
en: O girl of faultless proportions, on account of your good dealings no one in the city or in the palace, even none of your servants, is displeased with you.

sa: पापकर्मतया चैव संकरं तेन पुष्यति। संकरो नरकायैव सा काष्ठा पापकर्मणाम्।।३३।
en: From his evil deeds spring confusion of castes; and a mixing up of castes is the way to hell, for it is the very culminating point of sinful deeds.

sa: तेषामपनयं श्रुत्वा मेने स कृतकृत्यताम्। कृतार्थानां हि भृत्यानामेतद् भवति चेष्टितम्॥
en: Hearing of this act of indulgence on their part, he (Sugriva) thought they successful, for such behaviour could be possible for those servants whose efforts were crowned with success.

sa: तस्याहं सदृशान् दारान् राजेन्द्र समुपाहरम्। जित्वा पार्थिवसङ्घातमपि ते बहुशः श्रुतम्॥
